keeper_of_the_light_bright_speed.name: Bright Speed
keeper_of_the_light_bright_speed.description:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every %intelligence_per_speed% Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves %movement_per_vision% distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see %vision_radius% range for %vision_duration% seconds.

keeper_of_the_light_illuminate.name: Illuminate
keeper_of_the_light_illuminate.description: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
keeper_of_the_light_illuminate.lore: The light hidden within Ezalor manifests in wondrous form.

keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light.name: Blinding Light
keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light.description: Creates a flash of blinding light at the target location, knocking back and blinding all enemies, causing their attacks to miss. Enemies are knocked back %knockback_distance_tooltip% units over %knockback_duration% seconds.
keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light.note0: Knocked-back units destroy trees in a 150 radius upon landing.
keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light.lore: The primal light bends the course of battle in favor of Ezalor and his allies.

keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.name: Chakra Magic
keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.description: Restores mana and reduces the cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown. Has %self_bonus%%% increased effect when cast on self.
keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.lore: In this way, Ezalor is able to bestow harmony upon others.
keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.note0: Does not reduce the cooldown of ultimate abilities.

keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form.name: Spirit Form
keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form.description: Transforms the hero's body into pure light, granting increased cast range and enhancing the movement speed bonus from Bright Speed. In this form, Illuminate is cast by a separate spirit and heals allies.
keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form.facet_keeper_of_the_light_facet_solar_bi: Grants the Solar Bind ability while active.
keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form.facet_keeper_of_the_light_facet_recall: Grants the Recall ability while active.
keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form.lore: Ezalor reveals his true nature in a brilliant flash of light.
